findings.claim: kmctl's README says auditing a folder of docs against the code 'moved to its own package, kmaudit'. Nothing moved: v0.12.2 users had the action's audit mode (audit: docs-vs-code, okf-vs-code, okf-vs-docs), the /audit skill and the kmctl-auditor agent, and all three still ship unchanged. kmaudit is a new, separate package. A v0.12 user who runs mode: audit would read this as having to install kmaudit, and it contradicts the same README's intro (line 12) and /audit entry (line 312).
